entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A magical archer and conservationist planeswalker, last survivor of Skalla, with a strong connection to wild animals.

entities.name: Skalla
entities.description: Vivien's home plane, where advocates of progress and guardians of nature failed to find balance.

entities.name: The Arkbow
entities.description: Vivien's magical weapon, able to preserve the life force of dying beasts and summon powerful spirit incarnations.

events.summary: Vivien is the last survivor of Skalla, whose advocates of progress and guardians of nature failed to find balance.
events.quote: She is the last survivor of Skalla, a plane where advocates of progress and guardians of nature failed to find balance.
